name: Austerlitz
note: Austerlitz, 1805 (docs/plans/active/one-map-austerlitz.md): a 6 km map (decision 0061). Step 1, the real relief alone: the field's heights from ČÚZK's terrain model, one piece over the whole extent, centred on the crop's centre. The designed map (pieces moved closer, the 1805 features) is step 4.

sources.ref: ČÚZK DMR 4G, 49.118 N 16.737 E, a transverse Mercator centred there
Habsburg First Military Survey (Josephine), Moravia, 1764-1768, 1:28,800; WMS layer Military1 of Chartae Antiquae (VÚGTK and HÚ AV ČR)

sources.note: control points at landmarks (Wikidata, CC0): the churches of Prace, Telnice and Újezd, the chapel of St Anthony, Sokolnice castle, the belfry of Kobylnice, Peclův mill; each pixel read off the scan. The survey is off by about 560 m between them (each point where the others put it: docs/plans/done/m7-editor.md M7e)

features.note: the real ground: today's terrain, so modern embankments and quarries are still in it until step 4 levels them
